'''Project DS-5''' was an experiment of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[CZ-198]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Located in a [[Waste Disposal|sewer]] of the Czerka research facility on the moon, the mysterious subject attacked and was defeated by forces who recovered a vital [[anti-toxin]] trashed by employees of the embattled station.
